```{r}
# ============================================
# SETUP AND PACKAGE LOADING
# ============================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6
)

# Load libraries silently
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(gridExtra)
})

music_data <- read.csv("data.csv")

head(music_data) %>%
kable(caption = "Preview of the Music Dataset") %>%
kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
full_width = FALSE)

# ============================================
# DATA CLEANING PROCESS
# ============================================

cat("🧹 **DATA CLEANING PROCESS**\n\n")

# Step 1: Select only required columns
cat("**Step 1: Selecting Required Features**\n")
required_cols <- c("acousticness", "artists", "danceability", "energy", "id",
                   "liveness", "loudness", "name", "popularity", "speechiness",
                   "tempo", "valence")

# Keep only columns that exist in the data
available_cols <- required_cols[required_cols %in% colnames(music_data)]
music_data <- music_data[, available_cols]

cat("- Selected", length(available_cols), "required features\n")

# Step 2: Handle missing values
cat("\n**Step 2: Handling Missing Values**\n")
initial_count <- nrow(music_data)

# Remove rows with missing values
music_data_clean <- na.omit(music_data)
cleaned_count <- nrow(music_data_clean)

cat("- Initial observations:", initial_count, "\n")
cat("- After removing NA values:", cleaned_count, "\n")
cat("- Observations removed:", initial_count - cleaned_count, "\n")

# Update dataset
music_data <- music_data_clean

# Step 3: Check for duplicates
cat("\n**Step 3: Checking for Duplicates**\n")
duplicate_rows <- sum(duplicated(music_data))
cat("- Duplicate rows found:", duplicate_rows, "\n")

if(duplicate_rows > 0) {
  music_data <- music_data[!duplicated(music_data), ]
  cat("- Duplicates removed\n")
}

cat("\n🎯 **CLEANING SUMMARY**\n")
cat("- Final dataset:", nrow(music_data), "tracks ×", ncol(music_data), "features\n")
cat("- Missing values: 0\n")
cat("- Ready for analysis: ✅\n")
